SELECT r.id,
    x.n
   FROM vd14_t r,
    LATERAL ( SELECT (r.g * 2) AS n) x;

SELECT a.i,
    a.j
   FROM ( SELECT vd14_t.id,
            vd14_t.g
           FROM vd14_t) a(i, j);

SELECT vd14_t.id
   FROM vd14_t
UNION
 SELECT vd14_t.g AS id
   FROM vd14_t
  ORDER BY 1
 LIMIT 5;

SELECT vd14_t.id
   FROM vd14_t
UNION ALL
 SELECT vd14_t.g AS id
   FROM vd14_t
  ORDER BY 1 DESC
 OFFSET 1;

WITH RECURSIVE r(n) AS (
         SELECT 1 AS "?column?"
        UNION ALL
         SELECT (r_1.n + 1)
           FROM r r_1
          WHERE (r_1.n < 5)
        )
 SELECT r.n
   FROM r;

WITH RECURSIVE r(n) AS (
         SELECT 1 AS "?column?"
        UNION ALL
         SELECT (r_1.n + 1)
           FROM r r_1
          WHERE (r_1.n < 3)
        )
 SELECT (r.n * 10) AS m
   FROM r;

SELECT vd14_t.id
   FROM vd14_t
  WHERE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM vd14_t vd14_t_1
          WHERE (vd14_t_1.g = 10)));

SELECT r.a
   FROM vd14_t r(a, b, v, t);
select r.a, r.b from vd14_t r(a, b) where r.b > 10 order by 1;
select count(*) from vd14_t as x(p, q) where q = 10;
